review.notes: All 22 bilingual entries read in full and considered with both native purpose prefixes. ItemDeliveryQuest selects these purpose fragments only for cooking items. Both Greek prefixes supply neuter προϊόν and για να; object pronouns and verb forms fit each purpose. Native band/book substitutions confirmed, allowing explicit βιβλίο/συγκρότημα wrappers. The source listening fragment is rendered as enjoying the food while listening to keep the composed sentence grammatical. Every evening/tomorrow/season distinction and request retained.
